meta.tagline: An AI workflow guide for privacy, authorship, and academic judgment
meta.note: Routing logic is enforced by rules-engine.js (Week 3). This file is content-only configuration.

layers.description: Trusted records, published scholarship, officially approved policy. Safe for AI reference with proper attribution. AI output cannot return to this layer without human review.
Work in progress — research drafts, developing policy language, course materials under revision. Safe for AI assistance with human review before adoption.
A curated extract of reviewed, non-restricted materials prepared specifically for AI processing. Token-budgeted and confirmed clean.
AI-generated content, drafts, and summaries. Must be reviewed before use. Cannot be re-introduced to Layer 1 (Canonical Source) without explicit human validation.
FERPA-protected student data, personnel records, confidential institutional communications. Must never enter external AI systems under any circumstances.
Conference papers, published guides, press materials, and approved public communications. Safe after review cycle is complete.

enforcedRules.label: No Recursive Upload
enforcedRules.description: AI-generated output (Layer 4) cannot flow back into Layer 1 (Canonical Source) without explicit human review and validation. Enforced as a UI checkpoint in the packet builder.

enforcedRules.label: Never External AI
enforcedRules.description: Layer 5 materials must never be submitted to any external AI tool, API, or cloud service. This rule cannot be overridden by any mode or configuration.

materialCategories.label: Committee Notes
materialCategories.description: Minutes, notes, or records from faculty or administrative committee meetings.

conditions.label: Contains personnel discussion
conditions.message: Committee notes containing personnel discussions are restricted. Do not enter external AI tools. Extract and isolate personnel content before any AI processing.

conditions.label: Procedural content only — no personnel references
conditions.message: Procedural committee notes are safe for AI assistance with review. Confirm no personnel content is present before building into packet.

materialCategories.label: Draft Policy Language
materialCategories.description: Working drafts of institutional policies, governance documents, or procedural guidelines not yet officially adopted.

conditions.label: Pre-approval draft
conditions.message: Draft policy language is safe for AI assistance. AI output must be reviewed before adoption. AI-generated revisions cannot become official policy without the standard approval process.

materialCategories.label: Approved Institutional Policy
materialCategories.description: Officially adopted policies, governance documents, or procedures that have completed the institutional approval process.

conditions.label: Officially adopted
conditions.message: Approved policy is canonical. Safe for AI reference and citation. Do not modify without completing the official approval process. AI summaries must cite the source document.

materialCategories.label: Personnel Records
materialCategories.description: Faculty personnel files, evaluation records, reappointment or tenure documentation, HR correspondence, or any record linked to an individual's employment status.

conditions.label: Personnel record (any type)
conditions.message: Personnel records are always restricted. Never enter external AI tools. Institutional data governance and applicable law apply.

materialCategories.label: Published scholarship or public research output
materialCategories.description: Peer-reviewed articles, books, conference papers, or other officially published scholarly work.

conditions.label: Published and publicly available
conditions.message: Published scholarship is a canonical source. Safe for AI reference and citation. AI summaries must cite the source document and cannot replace scholarly attribution.

materialCategories.label: Own unpublished draft or work in progress
materialCategories.description: Sole-authored unpublished manuscripts, article drafts, book chapters, or working papers not yet officially submitted or published.

conditions.label: Sole-authored, not submitted
conditions.message: A sole-authored unpublished draft may be used for AI-assisted revision with human review. Check tool terms of service and any applicable funder or institutional restrictions.

materialCategories.label: Co-authored unpublished material
materialCategories.description: Unpublished manuscripts, drafts, or research material with one or more co-authors.

conditions.label: Co-authored, consent not established
conditions.message: Co-authored unpublished material should not enter external AI tools unless all co-authors have explicitly agreed and any applicable publication agreements, funder restrictions, and institutional policies have been reviewed.

materialCategories.label: Grant proposal or fellowship application
materialCategories.description: Grant proposals, fellowship applications, or related funding documents in preparation or under review.

conditions.label: Grant or fellowship — funder rules apply
conditions.message: Grant and fellowship materials may be AI-assisted with careful human review. Confirm funder and institutional policies on AI-assisted proposal writing before use.

materialCategories.label: Human-subjects, IRB, interview, fieldnote, or restricted research material
materialCategories.description: Research data from human subjects, identifiable interviews or fieldnotes, IRB-covered materials, or any restricted research data.

conditions.label: IRB or human-subjects material
conditions.message: Human-subjects research data, identifiable fieldnotes, interviews, and IRB-covered materials must not enter external AI tools without explicit institutional and IRB authorization.

materialCategories.label: Manuscript or Research Draft
materialCategories.description: Unpublished research writing, article drafts, book chapters, or grant narratives in development.

materialCategories.label: Course Syllabus
materialCategories.description: A syllabus or course outline, approved or in development.

materialCategories.label: Student Work or Feedback
materialCategories.description: Any student-submitted work, evaluations, feedback data, or records that identify individual students.

conditions.label: Contains student-identifiable information
conditions.message: Student records are FERPA-protected. Never enter external AI tools. Aggregate or fully anonymized data may be routable — verify with your institution's FERPA officer before proceeding.
